task_description: Complete rewrite of IVA Scanner from C# to Python. Delete all old code, build a Telegram bot with smart 3-phase card scanning, distributed worker system via SSH/Docker, and advanced logging. All UI in Persian via Telegram panels.

verification.summary: All 21 Python files parse without SyntaxError. All internal imports have valid structure. No old C# files remain. Directory structure matches architecture. External deps cannot be installed (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY) so runtime testing not possible, but all code is structurally sound. Review issues 1-6 addressed.

review_fixes.issue_1_credential_encryption: FIXED - config.validate() now requires WORKER_SECRET. Worker add refuses to store credentials without encryption. Account tokens encrypted with Fernet before DB storage.
review_fixes.issue_2_account_rotation: FIXED - _run_scan now iterates through all available accounts on rate-limit. Automatically switches to next account and continues from checkpoint.
review_fixes.issue_3_scan_checkpoint: FIXED - scan_jobs table has checkpoint_index column. Scanner calls on_checkpoint every N tests. Resume supported via resume_phase/resume_index/resume_found parameters. get_resumable_job() retrieves last unfinished scan.
review_fixes.issue_4_sqlite_concurrency: FIXED - Added asyncio.Lock (_write_lock) to db.py. All write operations go through _execute_write/_execute_write_returning which serialize concurrent access.
review_fixes.issue_5_worker_health_stale: FIXED - wk_health handler now calls deploy.check_worker_health() for each worker and updates DB. Periodic background health check loop added in bot/app.py (_periodic_health_check).
review_fixes.issue_6_handler_double_fire: FIXED - accounts.py handle_conversation raises events.StopPropagation after handling. app.py message_dispatcher also raises StopPropagation when handled.
review_fixes.issue_7_conversation_state: NOTED - v1 trade-off. In-memory state is acceptable for single-user bot. User gets notification on restart.
review_fixes.issue_8_deploy_network: NOTED - v1 trade-off. Deploy assumes VPN already configured on target server as stated in project requirements.
